facts.value: The registration phase usually begins three weeks before the start of lectures and ends after the first week of lectures.
primarily designed for business administration students, but students from other departments can register for the 'courses for all students'
You do not have to be proficient in any language, but you may take courses in two to three languages.
You may take 2 courses in English as well as one course in French and/or Spanish.
It does not matter whether B2.1 or B2.2 is achieved – what is important is that the overall level B2 is reached.
Our language certificates are generally unlimited in validity, meaning they do not have an expiration date and remain legally valid.
In practice, many institutions or universities often require a certificate that is not older than two years to ensure that proven language skills are still current.

For all inquiries, please contact us via email. This office will answer all questions about the courses in business languages. Please contact this address first and not the instructors. Emails that can only be answered by instructors will be forwarded to the correct address.
